text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Well done, brave Trainer.
Thou hast safely rescued the Umamusume princess."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Behold. Thanks to thy heroic efforts,
every single Umamusume princess across the multiverse hath been saved."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yet, one day, darkness shall once again enshroud all worlds...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Truth be told, the Umamusume Princess was the Demon King all along.
Until the day she awakens, I shall entrust her to you.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Listen well, an Umamusume princess's weakness is direct sunlight...
Do not forget these words of King Golshi...
